findings.desc: evidence-freshness.ts:143,218 isMaterialExcludedPath receives gitCwd instead of metadataRoot (root), violating the stated invariant in BuildDoneChecklistOptions.gitCwd and CHK-001 plan.md that "root (metadataRoot) still drives every config/store/audit read". In currentMaterialHash, isMaterialExcludedPath(filePath, gitCwd) calls loadConfig(gitCwd) — which looks for lattice.config.json in the gitRoot, not the metadataRoot. On a wrapper-root layout where lattice.config.json is at the metadataRoot (not at gitCwd) and storyDir is a custom prefix not covered by DEFAULT_STORY_METADATA_PREFIXES, story metadata files tracked in the gitRoot would not be excluded from the material hash, producing a different (larger) hash than expected and causing a false evidence-stale DONE block. The smoke test fixture uses storyDir=.lattice/story/actives which matches the default prefix so the bug is not caught. Fix: pass root (metadataRoot) to isMaterialExcludedPath in both call sites inside evidence-freshness.ts, keeping gitCwd only for the actual git invocation (ls-tree, rev-parse, diff). Same applies to changedFiles.filter at line 218.
